$description: Props per component, generated from the registry source by scripts/props.mjs; do not edit.

props.name: source
props.description: The robot, sensor or system that raised it.

props.name: time
props.description: When it was raised, already formatted by the app: "14:02:31". Shown first, in tabular figures.

props.name: title
props.description: What happened and where: "Collision risk · Hall B".

props.name: active
props.description: The condition is still present.

props.name: acknowledged
props.description: An operator has acknowledged it.

props.name: acknowledgedAt
props.description: When it was acknowledged, already formatted: "13:42". Shown as "Acknowledged 13:42".

props.name: clearedAt
props.description: When the condition cleared, already formatted ("14:07"). Shown while a cleared alarm waits for acknowledgement.

props.name: shelvedUntil
props.description: Shelved by an operator until this time, already formatted ("15:30"). A shelved alarm is out of the live list and silent; the app clears this field when the time comes, and the alarm returns. Critical alarms cannot be shelved.

props.name: suppressed
props.description: Suppressed by design: the app's logic says it does not apply now (a docked robot's "not moving"). Counted, not shown.

props.name: outOfService
props.description: Out of service: taken off for maintenance by an authorised person. Counted, not shown.

props.name: raisedAt
props.description: When it was raised, in ms since the epoch. Needed only for flood detection.

props.name: onAcknowledge
props.description: Shown while unacknowledged. Without it the alarm is read-only (for viewers).

props.name: onShelve
props.description: Shows "Shelve" (not on critical alarms). The app asks how long, then sets `shelvedUntil`.

props.name: onUnshelve
props.description: Shows "Unshelve" on a shelved alarm.

props.name: action
props.description: The corrective action, e.g. "Open camera".

props.name: onAcknowledgeAll
props.description: "Acknowledge all" in the header: only when you pass it, since a product may require every alarm to be read and acknowledged on its own. Shown while two or more alarms it may take are unacknowledged and in view. It is called with those ids only: never a critical alarm (each is acknowledged on its own row), never shelved, suppressed or out-of-service ones, and the low alarms folded in a flood only while their group is open.

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<AlarmLabels> & { title?: string; summary?: (active: number, unacknowledged: number) => string; none?: string; acknowledgeAll?: string; acknowledgeShown?: (count: number) => string; acknowledgeNonCritical?: (count: number) => string; acknowledgedCount?: (count: number) => string; shelvedGroup?: (count: number) => string; hidden?: (suppressed: number, outOfService: number) => string; flood?: (count: number, minutes: number) => string; lowGroup?: (count: number) => string; many?: (count: number) => string; loading?: string; errorEmpty?: string; errorStale?: string; updatedAt?: (time: string) => string; retry?: string; }

props.name: flood
props.description: More than `count` alarms raised within `minutes` is a flood (ISA-18.2: over 10 in 10 minutes per operator). The list says so, keeps critical and high on top and folds low alarms into one row. Needs `raisedAt` on the alarms.

props.name: now
props.description: The current time in ms, for flood detection. Defaults to the clock; pass it to make a story or test stable.

props.name: feedback
props.description: Buzz and sound for a new critical or high alarm (the `feedback` patterns). On by default; turn off where the list is a record, not a live feed.

props.name: status
props.description: Where the alarms come from. "loading": rows held by placeholders, never "No active alarms". "error": the list says it could not load or update, keeps the alarms it already has (an old list beats an empty one), and offers `onRetry`.

props.name: updatedAt
props.description: When the alarms were last loaded, shown with an error: "Last updated 13:42".

props.name: src
props.description: The picture. Or pass `image` to draw your own (a canvas, a video frame).

props.name: image
props.description: The picture as an element, in place of `src`; it should fill its box (size-full).

props.name: width
props.description: The picture's natural size in pixels: the coordinate space of the annotations, and the box's aspect ratio.

props.name: label
props.description: What the picture is, e.g. "Camera 2, aisle 3, 14:08". The annotations are summarised after it for screen readers.

props.name: selectedId
props.description: The annotation drawn as selected: 3 px in the focus ink, with handles.

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: Makes each annotation a button (one Tab stop, arrows move, Enter selects, Esc clears). Without it nothing is focusable.

props.name: showLabels
props.description: Which class words show on the picture. `selected` keeps a crowded picture readable; the words are still read out.

props.name: legend
props.description: The line-style legend under the picture, for the kinds present. On by default; off when the page has its own.

props.name: overlays
props.description: Raster layers drawn between the picture and the marks, in order.

props.name: loading
props.description: Show the box at the picture's aspect ratio, breathing, until the picture and its annotations arrive.

props.name: kinds
props.description: The kinds to list, in this order: predicted, ground truth, previous version.

props.name: size
props.description: Bytes.

props.name: progress
props.description: 0–100 while uploading.

props.name: leaving
props.description: Removed from the list: plays the exit, then calls onLeft. Pair with usePresenceList.

props.name: debounce
props.description: Call `onQueryChange` only once the typing has paused this long (ms). The text box itself never waits; clearing never waits.

props.name: filter
props.description: Filter options by the typed text. Turn off when the server filters.

props.name: showTrigger
props.description: A chevron that opens the full list.

props.name: tone
props.description: neutral (default) for news and calm conditions; info only while a process runs; warning before something is lost; danger when the app cannot work.

props.name: icon
props.description: Replaces the tone's icon with one that says what it is about: Wrench for maintenance, Lock for read-only, CloudOff for offline.

props.name: title
props.description: The condition in a few words, in bold: "Read-only mode". The children say what it means and until when.

props.name: action
props.description: One next step: a Button (size md, variant outline) or a link through `<Button asChild>`. Named by its result: "Upgrade plan", not "Learn more".

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Shows a close button. Remembering that it was closed (and for how long) is yours: set `open` false and store it. Leave it out for a condition that ends by itself (offline, read-only).

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: The close button's name for screen readers.

props.name: open
props.description: false hides it with the disappear movement. Default true.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render the child element (e.g. a link) with button styles.

props.name: loading
props.description: Disables the button (no double submit) and shows a spinner after 300 ms, so quick actions never flash. It keeps its look: busy is not unavailable.

props.name: label
props.description: The camera's name: "Front camera". Names the feed with `source`.

props.name: source
props.description: The robot it is on: "Patrol dog 7F3A".

props.name: stream
props.description: A WebRTC stream, set as the video's `srcObject`. The app owns the connection; the feed only shows it.

props.name: src
props.description: A URL the browser plays by itself (a live MP4 or WebM, or HLS where the browser supports it). Use `stream` or `src`.

props.name: status
props.description: What the connection is doing. Defaults to `live` when there is a `stream` or `src`; with neither, "No camera".

props.name: latencyMs
props.description: Glass-to-glass delay, measured by the app, written after "Live".

props.name: staleAfterMs
props.description: With no new frame for this long, the feed says "Stalled" over a dimmed picture instead of freezing silently.

props.name: offlineReason
props.description: Why the camera is offline, written under "Camera offline": "the robot is out of network range."

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Shows "Reconnect" while offline. Without it there is no button (a `src` reloads itself after a video error).

props.name: onSnapshot
props.description: Shows "Take snapshot": the frame on screen, drawn to a canvas, as a PNG.

props.name: audio
props.description: The stream carries sound: adds Mute. It starts muted (browsers block sound until someone asks for it).

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: Width over height, so the layout holds its size before the first frame. 16 / 9 by default.

props.name: children
props.description: Drawn over the picture, in a layer the size of the video box: a crosshair, detection boxes.

props.name: actions
props.description: Controls: the Chart / Table switch, a range.

props.name: children
props.description: What comes under the title: a CardFigure, a one-line summary.

props.name: formatter
props.type: Formatter<number, string> & ((value: number, name: string, item: TooltipPayloadEntry, index: number, payload: TooltipPayload) => ReactNode | [ReactNode, ReactNode]) & ((value: number, key: string) => ReactNode)
props.description: Function to customize the value in the tooltip. If you return an array, the first entry will be the formatted "value", and the second entry will be the formatted "name"

props.name: labelFormatter
props.type: ((label: ReactNode, payload: readonly Payload<number, string>[]) => ReactNode) & ((label: ReactNode, payload: TooltipPayload) => ReactNode) & ((label: unknown) => ReactNode)
props.description: The formatter function of label in tooltip.

props.description: Show this many chips, then "N more".

props.name: allowNone
props.description: Pressing the selected chip clears the choice.

props.name: linkAs
props.description: Your router's link (e.g. next/link), for chips with href.

props.name: control
props.description: A Checkbox, RadioGroupItem or Switch.

props.name: trailing
props.description: A count or a value at the end of the row.

props.name: code
props.description: The exact text; it is what Copy copies, also when `children` shows it highlighted.

props.name: title
props.description: Shown in the header and names the scroll box, e.g. a file name or "Terminal". Never put a secret here.

props.name: language
props.description: Shown in the header when there is no title.

props.name: wrap
props.description: "words" for shell commands (wrap between words, never inside a name); "none" scrolls sideways.

props.name: lineNumbers
props.description: Numbers each line in a gutter that stays put while the code scrolls; hidden from screen readers. With wrap="none" only.

props.name: secret
props.description: Hide the value behind dots, with a Show toggle; Copy still copies the real value.

props.name: copyLabel
props.description: The copy button's name, as is. Without it the name comes from `labels.copy(title)` ("Copy <title>", "Copy code").

props.name: children
props.description: Highlighted code (a `<pre>` from shiki or similar) shown in place of the plain text.

props.name: failedLabel
props.default: "Could not copy: select the text and copy it"
props.description: Said when the browser refused (no clipboard access); it stays until the next press.

props.name: size
props.description: sm: 44 px rows for long lists on a desktop. Separate from the theme's data-density, which this follows too.

props.name: displayFormat
props.description: date-fns pattern for the trigger.

props.name: disabledDays
props.description: Days that cannot be picked, in react-day-picker's matcher form, e.g. `{ before: new Date() }`.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Shows an × to clear the value.

props.name: children

props.name: action

props.name: delay

props.name: drop

props.name: label

props.name: aspect
props.description: Every tile keeps this shape before and after its picture loads, so nothing jumps.

props.name: size

props.name: loading

props.name: loadingCount

props.name: selection

props.name: selected

props.name: lightbox

props.name: onReveal

props.name: status

props.name: attention

props.name: open

props.name: edge
props.description: Persistent fault (stopped): changes the tray edge colour. Offline is neutral: say it, do not colour it.

props.name: loading

props.name: children

props.name: persistent

props.name: emphasis

props.name: onShowAll

props.name: labels

props.name: feedback

props.name: lead
props.description: Only when the icon carries meaning (event snapshot, step number). No decorative tiles.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Value text or InlineStatus. Filled badges belong in headers, not rows.

props.name: chevron

props.name: step

props.name: loading
props.description: While the next batch is on its way (when it is fetched, not just revealed).

props.name: tone
props.description: warning or danger colour the label; anything else stays neutral.

props.name: icon

props.name: detail

props.description: What the clip is, for the player's name: "Patrol dog 7F3A, front camera, 14:02".

props.name: src

props.name: poster

props.name: duration
props.description: Length in seconds from the clip's record, so the time and the markers show before the file's metadata arrives.

props.name: startAt
props.description: Where to start, in seconds: an incident clip opens at its event.

props.name: loading
props.description: The clip's URL is still being fetched.

props.name: unavailable
props.description: Known before loading that it cannot play: "the robot has not uploaded it yet." Shown after "Clip unavailable:".

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Called by the retry button. Without it, the button reloads `src`.

props.name: autoPlay
props.description: Starts muted on load, unless the person asked for reduced motion. Off by default: a clip waits for Play.

props.name: preload
props.description: How much to fetch before Play. `metadata` (default) gets the length; `none` saves data in a long list of clips.

props.name: low

props.name: critical

props.name: inline

props.name: label
props.description: What is counted: "Robots online". The link's text when the card has `href`.

props.name: value
props.description: The number, already formatted: "12", "1,204", "99.2".

props.name: unit
props.description: Written small after the value: "/ 14", "h", "%".

props.name: delta
props.description: Change against the previous period: "+8%", "−2". A leading minus (- or −) turns the arrow down; no change ("0", "±0 %") has no arrow.

props.name: trend
props.description: Whether the change is good. Direction alone does not decide: a rise in events is bad. Only "bad" is coloured.

props.name: series
props.description: Last values, oldest first, drawn as a sparkline: beside the value from 640 px, under it on a phone. Two or more.

props.name: caption
props.description: One line of context under the value: "2 docked for charging", "Last 7 days".

props.name: href
props.description: Makes the whole card one link, to the page behind the number.

props.name: linkAs

props.name: loading

props.name: unavailable

props.name: labels
props.description: The words only screen readers hear (", better", ", worse", "Loading", "Not available"), to translate them.

props.name: viewport

props.description: Stop when no pointer event arrives for this long, in ms. Default 2000. A held key is not timed: its release is reliable.

props.description: The robot's measured speed in m/s, shown while driving ("Driving · 0.4 m/s").

props.name: disabled
props.description: The robot cannot be driven by hand now. Say why in `disabledReason`.

props.name: disabledReason
props.description: Shown after "Disabled:", e.g. "robot in autonomous mode".

props.name: mode
props.description: inline: one text with both kinds of change marked. side-by-side: before on the left with its removals, after on the right with its insertions.

props.name: beforeLabel
props.description: Column headings in side-by-side mode, e.g. "Base model" and "Fine-tuned".

props.name: showSummary
props.description: The "+3 words, −1 word" line above the text.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the group.

props.name: step
props.description: Minutes between slots.

props.name: unavailable
props.description: Slots that exist but cannot be picked.

props.name: align
props.description: alternate puts time on one side and content on the other (vertical, wide screens only).

props.name: size
props.description: sm: less space between events, for a long history.

props.name: time
props.description: Shown as written ("09:41", "Yesterday").

props.name: dateTime
props.description: Machine-readable time for the <time> element.

props.name: tone
props.description: A status, drawn as its glyph. Leave empty for an ordinary event.

props.name: icon
props.description: An icon instead of a dot, e.g. for kinds of event.

props.name: size
props.description: sm: tighter rows for a long run. Rows you can open stay 44 px.

props.name: total
props.description: Length of the whole run in ms. With it, steps that have `start` and `duration` draw a waterfall bar.

props.name: description
props.description: One line under the title: the reason for a failure, a short result.

props.name: meta
props.description: A muted detail beside the title: the tool, the robot, the model.

props.name: icon
props.description: Replaces the status mark with an icon for the kind of step; the status is still announced.

props.name: duration
props.description: In ms.

props.name: start
props.description: Offset from the start of the run in ms, for the waterfall bar.

props.name: time
props.description: A clock time, shown as written.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the tree or list for screen readers: "Lineage", "Dataset files".

props.name: mode
props.description: list (default): a nested list whose links and disclosure buttons are ordinary Tab stops. select: a tree widget (role="tree"), one Tab stop, arrow keys, and one selected node.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Branches open at first (uncontrolled).

props.name: expanded
props.description: Open branches, controlled; pair with onExpandedChange.

props.name: expandAll
props.description: Every branch open at first (uncontrolled), for short trees people read whole.

props.name: selectedId
props.description: select mode: the selected node, controlled; pair with onSelectedChange.

props.name: defaultSelectedId
props.description: select mode: the node selected at first (uncontrolled).

props.name: empty
props.description: Shown instead of the tree when items is empty.

props.name: linkAs
props.description: Your router's link (e.g. next/link), for nodes with href in list mode.
